title: AI-Assisted Website Auditor
summary: Crawls a site like a real browser and explains what's wrong in plain language.
problem: Manual website audits are slow, inconsistent and hard to turn into a fix list.
solution: An asynchronous auditing workflow: rendered-page inspection, responsive screenshots, accessibility and performance diagnostics, and LLM-written explanations with structured response validation and fallbacks for malformed output.
result: Repeatable audits that end in an exportable report and a structured backlog of fixes.
